author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Azahar 2125.1.1: official development build
summary: Azahar published 2125.1.1 on April 21, 2026. The release record documents an official development build for the Nintendo 3DS emulator project.

blocks.text: The Azahar project published version 2125.1.1 on April 21, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: Fixed a regression introduced in 2125.1 where Azahar could appear to have rounded window corners while fullscreened. @PabloMK7 2049. Fixed a regression introduced in 2125.0 where a small number of games could crash due to a shadow texture handling oversight. @PabloMK7 2047. Changed a newly introduced use of the std::powf function in 2125.1 to use std::pow instead, restoring wider build environment compatibility. @cobalt2727 2045. Miscellaneous OpenBSD build fixes. @OpenSauce04 2052.
